data.define: A day with extremely hot weather.

misuse.text: Don't say 'scorcher' about a cold morning.
misuse.why: It means a very hot day.

data.l1_hook: Солнце палит. Даже в тени жарко — это «scorcher».

native.tip: “scorcher” = знойный день. Пример: “Today is a real scorcher!”
